en: Just kill us! Grand Tutor Wen's assassins will get us sooner or later anyway...
Grand Tutor Wen! Yin Wen!?
Boo hoo hoo~ Father...
Father? Don't tell me you two are King Zhou's...
That's right! I'm Yin Hong, King Zhou's eldest son.
And I'm Yin Jiao.
So you killed your own father to seize the throne... King Zhou was a tyrant, sure, but a son killing his father? That's unforgivable!
No! You've got it wrong, bird-brother! We didn't kill Father...
It was all the Regent, Grand Tutor Wen! To steal Father's throne, he pushed him off the Star-Plucking Tower and pinned the blame on us two... Boo hoo hoo...
Yin Wen...
Bro...
Monkey-face...

All right. You two travel with us for now. Once things calm down, I'll take you back to Xiqi to see my old man. He and my big bro will look after you. And don't worry about that Regent Wen guy. He and I have a score to settle!
Thank you!
We brothers will never forget your kindness...
Always playing the good guy, huh, Beanpole!
Yin Wen came here because of me... I can't let him keep going down the wrong path...
Okay, Monkey-face, enough of that. Don't forget there's still Yuyi Sage at Sanshan Pass.
Almost forgot, Busybody. Let's go!
Hmph!
Hmph! You reckless brats! Should I praise your spirit, or laugh at your stupidity? Ho ho ho...
Why don't you take your time finding out!
Ugh... this is... the Vermilion Bird Sword... Lady Shiji... I'm coming... to you...
Hmph! See that, stinky Taoist? Jin'ao Island doesn't scare me one bit!
Pipe down, Beakface! Let's go find Deng Jiugong!
Yeah, yeah! Beanpole!
You... you lot! Guards! Yuyi Sage!
Save your breath, gramps! Yuyi Sage went off to sell duck eggs in Suzhou!
Out... outrageous! Even if I stand alone, I'll repay King Zhou's favor by spilling your blood today!
Uncle Deng...
Please calm down and hear us out...
Your Highnesses!! It's you!
...And that's what happened.
So King Zhou was killed by Wen Zhong... I'll go to Zhaoge and slay that traitor now!
Uncle Deng... I hate to say it, but even you couldn't lay a finger on Grand Tutor Wen...
So I'm to sit here and wait for death? Boo hoo hoo...
Uncle Deng...
How about this! Deng Jiugong escorts the two princes to Xiqi, and we handle Zhaoge. What do you think, bro?
Great idea!
After how I treated you, you still... What a blind old fool I've been...
Well, your daughter's our teammate... and our pal Tu Xingsun's wife, too!
Since when did that girl get herself engaged? Why didn't I hear a word?
You locked her up the second she got home. When would she have told you? Ha ha ha...
True enough... ha ha ha... Silly old me. Guards~
Unlock the young lady at once!
Yes sir!
F-father-in-law... T-Tu Xingsun... greets you...
Ho ho ho... no need for formalities...
T-Tu Xingsun... will take good care of Chanyu forever... Please don't worry...
Ha ha ha... Hearing that puts my mind at ease. Ho ho ho...
What are you all chatting about so cheerfully?
N-nothing! Chanyu, are you okay?
Chanyu... you're not mad at your old dad, are you?
You only did it for my sake, Father, so I don't blame you...
Wow, the she-devil can be reasonable? I'm seeing her in a whole new light...
Did you say something just now, you old hag?
Nothing at all...
Tell you what! Everyone's tired today. If you don't mind, rest here tonight, and tomorrow I'll escort the princes to Xiqi.
Sure, we'll take you up on it!
Forget it! Can't sleep... Let's take a walk.
I'm so glad Father-in-law forgave us! Tu Xingsun will always treat Chanyu right!
Darling...
Chanyu, let's have lots and lots of kids!
Ugh~ you're awful! I'm not talking to you anymore...
D-did Tu Xingsun say something wrong? Sorry, Chanyu...
Tu Xingsun...
Those two lovebirds sure are happy~ I wonder what Xiaojun's doing now...
Xiaojun... Yin Wen...
Monkey-face! What are you spacing out here alone for?
Heh, I get it! You're thinking about your childhood sweetheart, Ji Xiaojun!
Got it right, didn't I!
M-mind your own business! I was just...
Just what? Hmm?
N-none of your business!
Just give up already! She's not the only girl in the world. Why tie yourself in knots over her? Nobody even knows if she's alive...
Shut up! What do you know, kid? Since we came to this world, no word from Xiaojun, and Yin Wen became Grand Tutor Wen... I don't know what to do... and you're making snide remarks...
S-sorry... I shouldn't have said that...

...Cheer up! Doesn't everyone say you're a General Star? I believe you came to this world for a reason, something you're meant to do. Stay positive! I'm sure one day you'll get the old Yin Wen back, and... and Ji Xiaojun too...
Thanks... I feel a lot better. It's late, go get some rest!
Clueless dope...!
Well then! This is where we part ways!
Tu Xingsun, I'm leaving my precious daughter in your care.
T-Tu Xingsun will take good care of Chanyu!
Ha ha ha... Hearing that, I can rest easy...
Your Highnesses, it's time we set off too!
Then we leave Zhaoge to all of you. I hate that we brothers can't help at all...
Grand Tutor Wen has lots of Jin'ao Island masters under him. Please be careful!
Leave it to us!
Uncle Deng, let's go!
Right! Time we got moving too!
Welcome to Peach Blossom Village!
Sigh... how are we supposed to get by?
North of Peach Blossom Village is the Peach Grove, and east is Jiameng Pass!
They say the Yin brothers killed King Zhou. True or not, Regent Wen Zhong is hunting them down.
We grow tons of peaches here, so we named it Peach Blossom Village!
Lately, right at harvest time, the peaches vanish for no reason. Is someone stealing them?
Up north is the Peach Grove where we grow peaches!
I heard it! The year before last, just before harvest, there were weird noises in the grove!
Sigh... what are we going to do?
Something wrong?

For some reason, these past few years, every time the peaches in the Peach Grove are ready to harvest, they vanish overnight without a trace. Tomorrow's harvest day again. If it happens this year too... we won't be able to make a living...
Leave it to us! We'll head to the Peach Grove tonight and get to the bottom of it.
We're counting on you!
What do we do?
I wonder if this year's peaches will vanish into thin air again...
Boo hoo... If they vanish again, my family will be living on air!
Let's sort out Peach Blossom Village's problem before moving on!
Coo... coo...
Huh? There's an injured parrot here...
Hurts to see one of your own kind wounded, huh, Beakface~?
My own kind!? Shut it, Beanpole!
The poor thing~ Can we take it with us?
Miss Yang Jian is so kind-hearted!
I give up! For once Busybody's showing a soft side, so fine, we'll bring it along!
Heh... thanks SO much for the compliment...
All right! Let's move out!
Peaches vanishing every harvest... so you two dragon freaks are behind it!
Hmph! You startled me! Just a bunch of humans and a mutant crow... Heh, that's right, we ate them. So what? Gonna bite me?
Y-you called me a mutant crow! You two tired of living or what!
Ha ha ha... Listen, mutant crow! Unless you want to be roast birdie, scram! Don't spoil our dinner!
I... I am NOT a mutant crow!
Why waste words on them! Get 'em, Beakface~!
Yeah!
Hmph! See that? Still think you can look down on me?
Ugh... you'll pay for this!
If... if you've got guts, come to Jiameng Pass! We'll be waiting there with our boss!
Hmph! Those two losers are all talk and no muscle.
Let's go tell Peach Blossom Village the good news.
Wonderful! Now Peach Blossom Village is saved!
Just like I said, some monster was eating the peaches before harvest.
They say Jiameng Pass to the east is guarded by three demon dragons.
So those weird noises I kept hearing were dragon demons stealing peaches in the grove...
Thank you so much!
Thank you! Without your help, we'd have been living on air this year! I simply must give you something!
Ah! I know! Take these embroidered shoes. They're my treasure! But you saved us, so I don't mind at all... R-really, I don't mind!
Don't worry! We'll give them back when we're done!
Promise! You have to give them back! Don't lie to me!
Got the Embroidered Shoes!
Don't worry, Sister Daji! We'll avenge you for sure!
Bro... if it weren't for me, Daji wouldn't have...
You really liked her, didn't you?
Yeah!
Bro...
Okay! Let's get going! Zhaoge isn't far now! We've got important business and can't dawdle!
B-but I...

Why dwell on it! The dead don't come back. Crying here won't revive Daji! Life and death are fate. Maybe our bond ran out in this life, but lives go round and round, and if we're meant to be, someday we'll be together...
B-bro! I understand!
I have no idea what you two are on about, but it's getting late. We should head out!
Yeah! Let's go, bro!
Yeah!
Well? What news?
Report, Your Majesty! Hu Ximei says General Su Hu and his daughter Su Daji are dead, and Ji Chang's heir Ji Pingyan is heading for Zhaoge...
Ji Pingyan...
You may go.
As you command!
Our great plan is only just getting on track. No one can be allowed to get in the way of our rule... not even Ji Pingyan...
I know that...
We must get rid of Ji Pingyan and his friends now, to avoid trouble later! Then I can rule this world.
My lady...
I understand! For you, my lady, what's one childhood friend? Even if I, Yin Wen, must turn to darkness...
Your Majesty truly is a dragon among men, one of a kind.
I'll summon the Jin'ao Island immortals and form the Ten Thousand Immortals Array! Ji Pingyan and Kunlun will fight me to the death!
How wise, Your Majesty!
Ha ha ha ha ha...
How can I help you?
A night's stay is 20 silver.
Found it!
You dragon losers again?
Are these the ones?
Yes! That's them!
You've disgraced the Dragon brothers! I expected three-headed monsters, and you lost to these brats!?
Big bro... don't underestimate these brats. They're way stronger than...
Enough! Not another word! Prepare to die, brats~!
Ugh... big bro... told you so!
Bl-blasted brats! Looks like we'll have to use THAT move...
Big bro, you mean... Got it!
Combine!!!
Wh... what...
Hmph! So they combined! Big deal!
Careful, bro! This giant dragon is nothing like those two were before...
I know! Everyone, fight carefully!
Ugh... how can this be...
Huff... huff... N-now you... know how... tough we are... huff...
That guy... if we'd let our guard down for a second...
M-monkey... face... huff... What do we do with them now?
Well...
Hmph! I lost! Kill me or carve me up, your choice...
Then I'll grant your wish right now!
Disciple~ You mustn't kill him!
Yun... Yunzhongzi?
M-Master!! What are you doing here?
The three Dragon brothers are ancient divine dragons. For stealing celestial peaches, the Jade Emperor banished them to Earth for 3000 years. Their term just ended, and then they ran into you...
Yunzhongzi, my friend, you mean... we can return to Heaven?
Exactly.
Th-then if you'd come a bit later, Master... I'd have made a terrible mistake?

Ho ho ho... Perhaps this was a trial set by Heaven! I'm taking the three dragons back to Heaven, and Leizhenzi, you've been down here long enough. Come back and train with me until you attain enlightenment.
But... but Master, I...
...Beakface! Just go back with your master! You're always tripping us up here anyway. It's no good! Right?
B-Beanpole, what are you saying? I'm dead weight to you? Fine! Remember this! I'm going back to Mount Zhongnan with Master to train! Just you wait, Beanpole! I'll make you eat those words! Hmph!
...Beakface...
I'll take my leave, then. Safe travels, everyone.
Monkey-face! Why'd you say something so harsh to Leizhenzi? Don't you know how much that hurts?

Sis! Bro did it for Leizhenzi's sake! If he hadn't said that, Leizhenzi would never have gone back to train. For us Kunlun disciples, attaining immortality is what matters most. Bro didn't want to ruin his future! Don't blame him... deep down he hates to see him go...
I-is that so...? S-sorry...
Let's go! Zhaoge's still a long way off!
You've truly made good friends, my child.
I know... I've always known...
It's getting late. Let's set off! If fate allows, you'll meet again, and I believe that day isn't far off.
Yes!
Beanpole, Nezha, Miss Yang Jian, wait for me. I'll be back. I'll come back stronger, I swear!
Let's come back here later!
Huh? What lovely zither music.
It is lovely, but there seems to be a deep sorrow hidden in it...
You can hear that too? Impressive!
It's getting dark. Why don't we ask the owner here to put us up for the night?
And you are?
S-so pretty...
Darling, did you just say something?
N-no, no! Tu Xingsun didn't say a thing!
Uh... h-h-h-h-hello there...
Hello.
Why are you stuttering all of a sudden?
M-mind your own business! Oh! I can't do this. Bro, you take it!
Uh... me? Um, well... we've j-just arrived in your fair land, and it's late... C-c-could we perhaps... st-stay the night?
Now you're stuttering too?
Please come in! If you don't mind how humble this little mountain cottage is...
No, no, no! Not at all!
Thank you so much, miss!
Yes yes yes yes yes!
What's gotten into these guys?
This room has always been empty. It's plain, so please bear with it! You haven't eaten yet, have you? I'll go fix you something.
Oh, you shouldn't! By the way... may I ask your name, miss?
D-did I say something wrong...?
I'll go get things ready. Excuse me.
Um... excuse me... is something troubling you, miss?
Why do you ask?

As we passed by, your beautiful playing stopped us in our tracks. The rise and fall, the effortless control... truly peerless. Yet in your music, I sensed a hint of loneliness and sorrow. A zither has a soul. When its owner is troubled, its sound echoes that feeling...
I never thought a boy could understand music so well... You even saw right through my heart...
Not at all. I only know the basics.
You're too modest...
Whatever trouble you're in, miss, don't be shy. Tell us!
Well... we've only just met by chance...
Sigh~ Besides, what I'm facing isn't something ordinary people can solve. Thank you for your kindness, but please don't worry about me...
Don't say that, miss! We're not afraid of any monster! Truth is, we're from Xiqi...
Shh! Darling! Don't tell her! What if she's an assassin from Zhaoge!?
Huh? No way! A girl this pretty couldn't possibly be...
Darling! What did you say? So pretty people can't be bad guys?
Well, you're not, Chanyu!
Oh... good point!
That's enough, you two...
Ha ha ha... You two lovebirds are too much.
Oh, I haven't introduced myself. I'm Ji Pingyan.
Ji Pingyan? You mean the Xiqi prince who slew the Dragon King, saved Jiulong Town and beat the Four Demons?
We're not as great as all that!
Your Highness, please accept this humble girl's bow...
Whoa! Please don't! Just tell us what's wrong, miss. We'll go through fire and water for you!
Yes! Rest easy, miss! We brothers won't let anyone wrong you!
Tu Xingsun too!

Thank you! For certain reasons, I've lived here in seclusion a long time. I thought if I stayed far from people, I'd live in peace, and this past year I did. But good times never last. Half a month ago, a Whale Fiend showed up at Yinmeng Lake...
A Whale Fiend! Has it been bullying you?
Not exactly... but it's set on making me...
...marry it...
Outrageous!
Totally!
That's despicable! I won't allow it, no matter what!
Of course we can't let that happen, but who are YOU to allow or not allow anything?
Did the Whale Fiend say when it's coming for the wedding?
Tomorrow at dawn...
That's a forced marriage! Don't worry! At dawn tomorrow I'll take your place and give that Whale Fiend a nasty surprise!
Give it a rest!
Monkey-face! You'd leave her to her fate?
I'm not. But you, pass for her? You're way too short... Unless that whale is blind, it'll see right through you!
......Then the she-devil can do it!
That won't work either!
Then what do we do? Big bro has six arms, and Tu Xingsun could never pass for a girl no matter how you dress him...
Hmm...
Huh!
I've got it!!
How could we forget him?
That's right! Looks-wise, he's the only choice!
Right! Right!
Wh-what's with those sinister looks?
It's decided! Monkey-face, you're going in drag!
Me? No way! Not over my dead body!
So, Monkey-face, you'll just watch this girl fall into the Whale Fiend's clutches?
Well... I...
Thank you all, but it's fine. Please don't argue over me. I'm a stranger to you, I'm not worth it...
Bro... I'm begging you, just this once...
Bro...
Fine, I'll do it!
But... if anyone breathes a word of this to Beakface, I'll never let them hear the end of it! Got that, Busybody?
Heh heh... got it!
My savior! Thank you... please accept my bow.
P-please don't! We'll do everything we can to help you, miss!
All right! What are you all standing around for? Do my makeup already!
How can we do makeup with nothing? Miss, if you don't mind, could you lend this monkey a makeup box, hairpin, embroidered shoes, blush and girl's clothes?
Afraid I'd run away, the Whale Fiend took all my things to its palace under Yinmeng Lake... All I can lend you is a hairpin!
Fine! Monkey-face! Let's search nearby Jizhou Pass and Peach Blossom Village!
Guess we have no choice!
Thank you all...
Thank you! Without your help, we'd have been living on air this year! I simply must give you something!
Ah! I know! Take these embroidered shoes. They're my treasure! But you saved us, so I don't mind at all... R-really, I don't mind!
Don't worry! We'll give them back when we're done!
Promise! Promise! Don't lie to me!
Welcome to Jizhou Pass.
I hear a Whale Fiend has shown up at Yinmeng Lake!
We're the Four Hide-and-Seek Kings of Jizhou Pass!
Ha ha ha... Dare to play with us?
Don't underestimate us!
Wanna play hide-and-seek with us? If you beat me, I'll give you this blush I found on the road!
Oh yeah? Knew you were too scared to take us on!
All right! You've got guts, mister! Count to 10, then come find us!
Told you you're no match for us! Ha ha ha...
You're really good, mister! As promised, the blush is yours!
You're so good, mister!
Wanna join our gang?
I can't believe we lost!
You're really good, mister!
Jizhou Pass is guarded by Lord Su Hu. They say his daughter Su Daji is as beautiful as a fairy from heaven, but... sigh...
Still pining for her? Sure, Daji's gorgeous, but she's rotten to the core! If she hadn't bewitched King Zhou with her looks, he'd never have neglected the court and become a cruel, tyrannical fool!
You said it! Looks aren't everything!
What matters most is a kind heart!
Boo hoo hoo...
Something wrong?
My mother is dying. The doctor says without four herbs from Qilin Cliff, calamus, dragon-drool grass, snow lotus and lingzhi, made into medicine, she can't be saved... Mother...
Qilin Cliff, huh? I'll fetch those four herbs for you. But I just saw you tuck a makeup box into your robe. Once I bring the herbs back, would you give it to us?
Thank you so much!
As long as my mother gets better, the makeup box is yours!
I've got the herbs! Hurry and brew them for your mother.
Thank you! I'll do it right away!
My... my child...
M-Mother, you're awake!
Yes... I feel like I... had a really... long dream...
That's great!
I can't thank you enough. As promised, here's the makeup box!
...Thank... you...
Thank you so much!
If not for that witch Su Daji, the country wouldn't be such a mess! Life's so miserable, it's worse than when King Zhou was alive!
Dad~ I don't think Sister Daji is like you say. She used to be really nice to me!
Quiet! What does a kid know?
Hmph! Daji's nothing special! A woman needs more than looks!
Exactly! What matters most in a woman is brains!
Right! Brains!
But sis, if you had to pick beauty or brains?
Need you ask? Beauty, obviously!
...Sob... So looks DO matter after all!
Boo hoo hoo... Heavens~ Let me be born as Daji next time!
...Sob... So looks DO matter after all!
Boo hoo hoo... Heavens~ Let me be born as Daji next time!
I watched Daji grow up! How did she become so cold and heartless? Is something going on behind the scenes?
Young man? Having trouble finding girl's clothes?
H-how did you know? Who are you two? Why do you always know exactly where we are?
You needn't know that, young man... Answer our five questions right, and this Rainbow Feather Robe is yours.
Are you serious?
Serious!
Then ask away, you two!
Listen carefully!
Nope~ Looks like you don't know this world well yet. Go learn a bit more and try again!
Put a little more thought into it!
Ho ho ho... Not bad, not bad!
We brothers judged you right. As promised, the Rainbow Feather Robe is yours.
Th-thank you!
Off you go! We'll meet again before long...
Meet again soon? Why?
Don't ask so many questions! Go on!
What a weird pair of brothers...
Okay! Got it! We're short on time. Back to Yinmeng Lake!
All right! Big bro, Tu Xingsun, wait outside a bit. I'm giving Monkey-face a total makeover!
I've got a bad feeling about this...
Get in here with me! Monkey-face~
Okay...
What are you standing there for, she-devil? Come in and help!
M-me?
Of course! Hurry up!
Fine! Quit nagging, you old hag!
What are you so shy about, Monkey-face?
Come on out!
No laughing, okay!
Why would I laugh at you, bro!
Tu Xingsun won't laugh either!
Absolutely, positively no laughing! And don't tell Beakface about this!
No promises I won't tell!
Tu Xingsun too!
...Okay!
I... I look hideous, right?
I-i-is that really you, bro?
...J-Ji... Ping... yan? So pretty!
Really? Don't lie to me! You're just saying that so I won't feel bad!
It's true! Even a goddess from heaven would be jealous of Monkey-face's beauty!
Oh, c-cut it out! That's so gross...
It's almost time! Let's go inside and wait for the Whale Fiend!
Good idea!
Is this really okay? You're taking such a big risk for me...
Don't worry, miss! I won't let any misfortune befall you.
Thank you... Nezha.
...Y-you're welcome!
Bro... Okay! Everyone inside! It's almost dawn!
It's up to you, bro!
No problem!
I bet bro has fallen for her. Once this is over, I'll do everything I can to help him out!
A noise! Is the Whale Fiend here?
Ha ha ha... So you were waiting here for me all along? They say when a girl says no, she really means yes. How true! I bet you're crazy about me! Ha ha ha...
Shy because I read your heart?
Ha ha ha... We're about to be husband and wife. Why so reserved?
Say, my dear, are you feeling unwell? Why won't you say anything?
